issue_context.title: [Feature]: Allow traces in test-results folder to have custom file extension e.g. `.pwtrace.zip`
issue_context.body:
### 🚀 Feature Request

Instead of using `.zip` use `.pwtrace.zip` as a file extension for trace files.

### Example

`trace.zip` -> `trace.pwtrace.zip`

or

`trace-1.zip` -> `trace-1.pwtrace.zip`



### Motivation

We like to identify trace files in our `test-results/` folder better. This is for a custom AzDO extension we are writing where we see a list files and would like to offer first-party Trace Viewer support.

HTML report doesn't work for us, since we use TRX file format in order to put the data back into AzDO. 

Note: This originates from the internal ODSP team.
comments:
@Skn0tt / @dgozman - Does implementation in #32581 change the default behavior for all users? i.e. If I use `npx playwright test --trace on` or `trace: 'retry-with-trace'` without any other config.

If so, that may[1] cause breaks for users who are relying on a stable name of trace output in their GitHub Actions/ADO Pipeline:

```
$ npx playwright test --trace on
$ ./upload.sh test-results/**/trace.zip
```

[1]: See GitHub Search for a number of pipelines that are effectively the above: https://github.com/search?q=path%3A*.yml+%22trace.zip%22+AND+playwright&type=code
Hey ross, thanks for the pointer! We discussed this in our team meeting and agree that we don't want to break those users. Gonna revert.
